title: I2C Transmit
text: Configure inter-integrated circuit (I2C) module to transmit data to I2C bus, 2 inputs, 1 output, {Addressing format} sets Address format for communication 7–Bit; {Module}, {peripheral address source}, {Peripheral address register}, {Bit count}, {Enable stop condition} sets the send stop bit to indicate that data transmission, {Enable repeat mode} sets the retransmit data until stop or start condition and {Output transmitting status} Indicates when I2C transmit block transmits. Values come from the instance.

ports.name: WD
ports.summary: Data written to I2C bus scalar | vector

params.name: Addressing format
params.values: Address format for communication 7–Bit addressing (default) | 10–Bit addressing | Free data format

params.name: peripheral address source
params.values: peripheral address source of I2C peripheral Specify via dialog (default) | Input port

params.name: Bit count
params.values: Bit count for communication 8 (default) | integer in [1 8]

params.name: Enable stop condition
params.values: Send stop bit to indicate that data transmission is complete off (default) | on

params.name: Enable repeat mode
params.values: Retransmit data until stop or start condition is detected off (default) | on

params.name: Output transmitting status
params.values: Indicates when I2C transmit block transmits message off (default) | on
